question: Where should the teacher establish the mace-headed liṅga?
premises: The teacher is the agent of establishment.
The place of establishment is the mace-mark.
inference: The teacher should establish the mace-headed liṅga on the mace-mark.
uncertainties: The precise ritual diagram referred to by gadā-aṅka is not detailed.
plain_english: But the teacher, having established the mace-headed liṅga on the mace-mark...
